content.title: About
content.content: Organic puffed amaranth is made from whole amaranth seeds that are heat‑treated until they become light and crunchy. It has a mild nutty flavor and works well in breakfasts, baked goods, and as a snack.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Amaranth is a pseudo‑cereal that was cultivated by ancient Andean and Mexican cultures.
The seeds are naturally gluten‑free, making them suitable for gluten‑free diets.
Organic amaranth is grown without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers.
Puffed amaranth retains most of the nutrients of the whole seed.
Amaranth is rich in lysine, an essential amino acid often limited in other grains.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Amaranth provides about 14 % protein, offering a valuable plant‑based protein source.

items.title: Rich in dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber supports healthy digestion and promotes satiety.

items.title: Source of micronutrients
items.content: The seeds contain magnesium, iron, phosphorus and zinc, important for metabolic functions.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Phytochemicals such as phenolic compounds help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Cardiovascular support
items.content: Beneficial fats and lysine contribute to normal cholesterol levels.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to amaranth.

items.title: Oxalate content
items.content: High oxalate levels can contribute to kidney stone formation in susceptible people.

items.title: Digestive reactions
items.content: Excessive intake may cause bloating or stomach discomfort due to the high fiber content.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Puffed amaranth can be mixed into oatmeal, yogurt, smoothies, used in baking, or enjoyed straight as a light snack. It pairs well with honey or dried fruit for added sweetness.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the puffed amaranth in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. For longer shelf life, keep it refrigerated to maintain crunch and prevent fat oxidation.
